scope: Separate local single-RTX3060 probability-loss shape-only ablation, with no Surface, appearance loss, RGB correction or combined method.

training.initialization: Completed frozen v2 epoch47; fixed stem/encoder and BatchNorm buffers; train only decoder with GroupNorm
training.precision: FP16 training with GradScaler; TF32 disabled. FP32 native evaluation with deterministic=False, benchmark=False, TF32 disabled. Restore training flags afterward.
training.selection: Freeze and exactly replay the initial checkpoint on this GPU before optimization. Include epoch zero. New epochs must meet both original Quadro and local full/hidden IoU floors; maximize hidden IoU, full-IoU tie-break, stable first. Epoch zero cannot be promoted.
training.input_mix: 75% SAM support, 25% annotated support. Empty training SAM uses annotated branch, counted explicitly.
training.augmentation: 50% horizontal flip, 25% extra half-plane occlusion, visible-derived crop padding 1.5-3.0
training.loss: Mean per-object binary cross entropy over pixels outside input support, with true amodal labels. Input SAM or augmented annotated support defines only which predictions can change at inference. No class weights, full/hidden Dice or positive-hidden bonus. Observable support remains clamped to one.
training.distributed_sampling: One-rank DistributedSampler with fixed seed; no padding, 9494 objects per epoch
training.accumulation: Global batch64 in microbatches8. Per-object BCE outside input support divided by the global object count, including the final incomplete microbatch. All9494 objects retained.

inference_geometry.input: RGB restricted to SAM support, SAM mask and its complement
inference_geometry.native_probability: Resize logits to native crop before sigmoid; zero outside crop; input SAM support set to one. Same geometry policy as frozen v2.

evaluation.validation: The existing 1264 objects / 217 images and recovered single-mask SAM diagnostic inputs
evaluation.hidden_truth: True amodal mask minus annotated visible mask, fixed across conditions
evaluation.status: Exploratory validation-driven development; no untouched confirmation claim
evaluation.success: The active all-four full-benchmark >=3% goal remains unchanged and unachieved; validation gains alone cannot satisfy it
evaluation.rationale: The complete fixed-epoch7 error audit attributes the support-restored full-IoU regression to extra false positives outside SAM support. Test proper probability supervision instead of the non-proper Dice/hidden-positive objective. This hypothesis is not established by the arithmetic attribution.
evaluation.benchmark_diagnostic_seen: The completed nonrandom 193-target frozen-v2 VG prefix has been observed; this is iterative research. No image-quality score enters training, checkpoint selection, or its validation constraint.
evaluation.engineering_repair: This is an explicitly separate platform protocol, not a relaxed replay for the queued Slurm/Kaggle runs. Both existing exact cross-GPU guards remain unchanged.
evaluation.platform_change: Distinct single-RTX3060 fallback for queued probability-loss Kaggle version1. Same loss, initial checkpoint, data, seed, epochs, learning rate and augmentations; single-rank sampling and accumulation differ from two-T4 DDP. Exact initial Quadro pixel replay is mandatory before optimization, and selected same-GPU pixel replay is mandatory. No equivalence of learned trajectories across platforms is claimed.

loader_diagnostic.change: Four CPU data-loader workers only; all model, loss, sampler, seed, batch, epoch, augmentation, geometry and selection settings retained
loader_diagnostic.limitation: 512 sampled input tensors and two real optimizer updates matched exactly; no full-trajectory or end-to-end timing claim
